Unto Captain Mr.butcher, Greetings.

Welcome to the shores of Sussex. I have drawn up the official trade grant for the agreed cargo—1,000 ounces of iron ore, 1,000 tons of stone, and 750 bushels of wood (£36,875.00).

The grant is prepared and will be delivered to you the moment you step ashore in Hastings. Our storehouses are ready to begin loading your vessel without delay.

I wish you a safe docking.

In Service,

Lord Michael Blackwood
Trade Minister of Sussex
